narration: Your file ends in MP4. What does ffprobe say is inside?
I inspect a real Fused export. Its filename names a container, but does not identify every stream.
I run ffprobe and read its structured output, which records what the file actually contains.
Here, the video uses H.264 and the audio uses AAC. They are separate streams in one container.
Its measured duration is 120.75 seconds. That describes our source export, not this short lesson.
Its frame size is 1080 by 1920 pixels. Those measurements belong to this particular file.
I compare those facts with the destination requirements before uploading.
That does not guarantee acceptance. I still watch and listen to the export.
The file contains video and audio. Its name alone could not tell me their formats.
